title: 🏦 AIFIs & SME Liquidity — ₹5,000 Crore SIDBI Equity Infusion & RXIL 21.6% Maiden Dividend
summary: Receivables Exchange of India Ltd (RXIL, promoted by SIDBI and NSE with SBI, ICICI, Yes Bank) declared maiden interim dividend of 21.6% on ₹10 face value shares.

blocks.content: **Overview**: Receivables Exchange of India Ltd (RXIL, promoted by SIDBI and NSE with SBI, ICICI, Yes Bank) declared maiden interim dividend of 21.6% on ₹10 face value shares.

items: **RXIL Becomes First TReDS Platform in India to Declare Dividend (21.6%)** (Page 47): Receivables Exchange of India Ltd (RXIL, promoted by SIDBI and NSE with SBI, ICICI, Yes Bank) declared maiden interim dividend of 21.6% on ₹10 face value shares.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Development Financial Institutions & MSME Factoring. DFS ₹5,000 Cr capital infusion into SIDBI across 3 tranches, and RXIL becomes 1st TReDS platform to declare a dividend.
